issues.title: Ingest Fulton County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $8,749,238 across 26 funds. The largest: County Road Fund ($2,234,301), County General Fund ($1,978,108), Law Enforcement Sales Tax Fund ($1,464,657). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
